justification: Frontend display-only change to the Intelligence Brief page: (1) the live progress bar froze at the last section's percent next to a 'Complete' badge when the streaming 'complete' event was dropped — now forced to 100% on the complete state; (2) raw internal NOT_AVAILABLE reason strings (e.g. 'Layer not ingested for this LGA') and a red 'Not Available' badge were rendered to users — now translated to five honest plain-language states with calm tones. No data, query, or regulatory logic changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: page.tsx renders DataField-wrapped sections; NOT_AVAILABLE fields printed reason verbatim with a red badge (SectionCard/SectionData). LiveStatusPanel shows server-sent streaming progress, forced to 100 only when a 'complete' event arrives; a dropped complete event left the bar at the last section value while the badge read Complete.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The UI assumed the streaming 'complete' event always arrives, and assumed internal reason strings are user-readable. Live run (25 Empire St) showed a dropped complete event (no Confidence Summary/Gaps cards rendered) freezing the bar at 81%, and showed raw 'Layer not ingested for this LGA' text.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component or fetch. One pure helper describeUnavailable maps reason strings to a five-state {label,tone}; three style maps drive tone. The progress prop gains a 'complete -> 100' branch. Existing confidenceBadge is unchanged for the positive confidence levels.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No external calls added. If a reason string is unrecognised, describeUnavailable falls back to a neutral 'Not included in this report' rather than throwing or leaking the raw string.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). reason is typed string|null and is normalised with (reason ?? '') before matching, so a null/undefined reason is handled. Tone is a closed union keyed into Record maps, so every tone resolves to a class string.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a finished report looked half-failed (Complete + frozen 81%) and showed internal pipeline jargon in red. After: the bar reads 100% on completion and empty fields read as honest plain states (None found / Available on request / Not assessed / Could not identify / Temporarily unavailable), most of which are neutral or good news.

functions.name: describeUnavailable
functions.input: an optional internal NOT_AVAILABLE reason string emitted by the backend brief for a data field
functions.output: an object with a plain-language user-facing label and one of five honest tone categories for styling
functions.if_none: a null, empty, or unrecognised reason returns a neutral 'Not included in this report' label so nothing internal ever leaks

values: N/A - no regulatory values. The mapping turns internal status strings into plain-language UI copy; no planning numbers are involved.
queries: N/A - this is a frontend render change; it adds no database or API query and reads only the already-streamed brief field data.

break_it.scenario: The streaming complete event is dropped so the bar would otherwise freeze below 100 next to a Complete badge
break_it.what_happens: the user sees a finished report that looks half-loaded and failed, exactly the reported 81%-with-Complete case
break_it.repro: force the stream-ended fallback path (no complete event); the progress prop now resolves to 100 when state is complete
break_it.how: progress is set to 100 whenever state is complete, independent of whether the complete event arrived, so the bar always matches the badge

break_it.scenario: A backend reason string is unrecognised by the mapping or is null for an empty field
break_it.what_happens: a naive map could render undefined, crash on a missing key, or leak the raw internal string to the user
break_it.repro: call describeUnavailable(null) and describeUnavailable('some new backend string') — both return a defined neutral fallback
break_it.how: reason is coerced with (reason ?? '') and the function returns a neutral default; tone indexes a Record covering all five union members

break_it.scenario: A reason that means good news ('No coastal hazard overlays at this location') must not be shown as an alarming error
break_it.what_happens: rendering it as a red 'Not Available' badge misreads a clean result as a failure for the owner
break_it.repro: describeUnavailable('No coastal hazard overlays at this location') returns tone 'clear' with green styling and 'None found at this property'
break_it.how: reasons starting 'no ' or containing 'none found'/'at this location' map to the clear tone (emerald), never red

break_it.scenario: An ambiguous 'failed or not requested' reason must not be shown as a hard error
break_it.what_happens: labelling an optional-not-requested add-on as 'failed' would alarm the user about a non-problem
break_it.repro: describeUnavailable('Bushfire pre-screen failed or not requested') returns the neutral 'Not included in this report'
break_it.how: when a reason contains both 'fail' and 'not requested' the mapping stays neutral rather than asserting an error it cannot confirm

post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy, run a brief that drops the complete event (or any complete brief) — the bar should read 100% with the Complete badge, no frozen percentage. Confirm empty environmental rows (riparian/wetlands) read as a calm plain state, not red 'Not Available' with internal text. The deeper streaming-reliability fix (recover the dropped complete event so the Confidence Summary/Gaps cards still render) and the live lot-level overlay check (#2) are tracked follow-ups, not in this change.
